scientific_integrity: The theorem uses the previously published expansion and exponential-age law; the new claim is the sharp spatial sign classification and its asymptotic regimes. Primary literature supplies related model inputs but no directly established equivalent classification was found. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact in the reset-age-mixed Thomas–Fermi hydrodynamic approximation. Not a theorem about microscopic quantum density fluctuations, finite-particle effects, non-Poisson resetting or uniqueness of the reset rate at which off-center covariance vanishes.
title: A sharp center-to-periphery covariance boundary for a reset Thomas–Fermi condensate
